message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant knowingly rented his property to a person who runs a gambling machine shop (illegal gambling). He provided venue for gambling. This is "组织、领导、参加赌博活动罪" or "为赌博提供场所罪". Under Chinese law, providing a venue for gambling is a crime: "为赌博提供场所罪" (Article 303 of Criminal Law). The penalty: up to 3 years, or more if circumstances. Also self-surrender (自首) can reduce penalty.

Thus answer: [罪名]为赌博提供场所罪<eoa>

Check if also "帮助组织赌博" but main is providing venue. So single crime.
